r1.why: Bernoulli trial/process from [2], n=1 reduces to Bernoulli from [3], binomial test from [4].

r2.why: Sequence probability [9], equal probability by independence [10], tables to n/2 via complement [11][12].

r3.why: E[X]=np [14], mean/median/mode coincide [25], p=0 and p=1 cases and modes [19][20][21].

r4.why: Estimator x/n [38], MLE and moments [39], unbiased min variance [40], asymptotic normality via CLT [42].

r5.why: With replacement [5], without replacement hypergeometric [6], approximation when N much larger [7].
